stories.title: Brewers sweep Dodgers in NLCS, advance to 1st World Series in 44 years
stories.summary: The Brewers completed a four-game sweep of the Dodgers to win the NL pennant and reach the World Series for the first time since 1982.

stories.title: 'We got outplayed': Dodgers tip cap to Brewers as title reign ends in sweep
stories.summary: The Dodgers' quest for a three-peat ended in a 6-4 loss to the Brewers, who defeated them so thoroughly in the NLCS that Los Angeles was left with little to second-guess.

stories.title: Darnold owns up to mistakes in OT loss: Late picks 'not fair' to Seahawks
stories.summary: Seahawks quarterback Sam Darnold called his two late interceptions against the Broncos "unacceptable" and vowed to be better after a 17-14 loss.
